name: Churn Solution
description:
Churn Solution's MCP server gives AI assistants secure access to your cancellation and retention data. Using natural language, investigate why customers leave, measure the impact of your cancel flows, identify at-risk accounts and revenue, track retention trends, and answer complex questions about your subscription business.

Built for founders and growth, product, and finance teams, it turns Churn Solution data into actionable retention insights and faster decisions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Churn Solution to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Churn Solution to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.churnsolution.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Churn Solution MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Churn Solution lists 14 MCP tools, including get_cancel_flow_metrics, get_cancel_flow_outcomes_by_flow, get_cancel_flow_revenue, get_cancel_flow_revenue_by_offer, get_cancel_flow_save_rate, get_feedback_category_breakdown, get_feedback_sentiment_trend, list_cancel_flow_cancellation_reasons, list_cancel_flow_cancellation_reasons_by_plan, list_cancel_flow_offer_performance, list_connections, and list_feedback_intents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Churn Solution?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Churn Solution in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Churn Solution MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Churn Solution requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Churn Solution is developed by Churn Solution. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
